_doc: Arcadia's levels and the ways between them (js/transit.js, js/map.js's cutaway, tools/bridge-art/atlas.py and audit_worlds.py read it). levels: top first; tag on the signs, floors the range the lift counter shows (below the street negative, shown B20). places: each main place's level and where it sits across the city (x 0 west .. 1 east) on the Map's side-on cutaway; rooms inside them aren't listed. shafts: express lifts, a lobby per stop (world, floor, spawn: where you step out). loop: the sky train's stations round the ring, in order. cabs: air cab pads. A world's interactions name them: express_lift {shaft, lobby}, loop_station {station}, air_cab {pad}. See apps/bridge/CLAUDE.md, Getting around Arcadia.
